# Buyer universe (hypotheses to verify)
This is canned replay text. It names no real buyers; a live run drafts a buyer universe from the model and the sector, and every name must be verified.
# Strategic buyers
Category: large technology platforms with adjacent product lines. Rationale: scale and distribution. Verify capacity to pay against their own filings.
# Financial buyers
Category: large-cap sponsors and sovereign funds. Rationale: cash generation of $145.1 billion supports leverage. Verify appetite and fund size.
